Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 1b) demonstrates bilateral widening of the lower posterior mediastinum with smooth, lateral displacement of both paraspinal lines (indicated by arrowheads) and no evidence of vertebral bone destruction. This radiographic pattern, combined with the clinical presentation of refractory back pain and lymphopenia in an elderly patient, is most characteristic of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving the paravertebral region.
